meta.name: cta-designer
meta.description: Design personalized, value-based call-to-actions (CTAs) for cold outreach that spark conversations instead of demanding meetings. Use when asked "what CTA should I use", "help me with my call to action", "how to end my email", "what lead magnet should I offer", "how to get a reply", "how to close my cold email", "CTA ideas for outreach", "what should I ask for in my sequence", or any request about how to end an outreach message or what to offer prospects. Always use this skill before writing or finalizing any outreach CTA. This skill replaces generic "book a call" CTAs with Permissionless Value Promises that make prospects respond out of genuine interest, not obligation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为冷邮件设计引发回复的价值型行动号召
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要让冷邮件获得更多回复而不是被忽略。
copy.tagline_en: Design value-based CTAs for cold outreach that spark replies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need cold emails that get replies instead of ignored.

howto.what: 当用户要求设计外联消息的CTA时，Claude会先收集对方背景（行业、角色、痛点等），然后生成5个不同类型的Permissionless Value Promise（PVP）CTA，这些CTA不要求预约会议，而是提供有价值的洞察、资源或问题，以引发对方回复。最后，Claude会根据上下文推荐最合适的1-2个选项。
howto.when: 当用户询问“我应该用什么CTA”、“帮我写个行动号召”、“如何结束邮件”等类似问题时触发；或者在用户要写或最终确定外联CTA时自动激活。

say.text: 帮我设计一个冷邮件的CTA，要能引起回复。
say.note: Claude会收集上下文并生成5个PVP选项。

say.text: 这个外联消息的结尾该怎么写？
say.note: Claude会提供不同角度的CTA建议。

say.text: 给一个针对数据分析师的CTA例子。
